units.source_text: 后来，我到名人房间向他暂时告辞，名人却只顾呆呆地仰望着庭院的上空。

en.t: Later, I went to the master's room to take my leave of him for the time being, but he only stared blankly up at the sky above the garden.

units.source_text: 名人本应从箱根旅馆径直住入筑地圣路加医院，但据说这两三天他不能乘坐交通工具。

en.t: The master was supposed to go straight from the Hakone inn to St. Luke's Hospital in Tsukiji, but it was said that for the next two or three days he could not ride in any vehicle.
